posts.title: Track Web pageviews with Prometheus
posts.description: I wanted to try my new Prometheus setup with some useful data, and since I want to learn how to use Prometheus, I thought it would be fun and useful to do this. In case you're not familiar with it, Prometheus is a server app that gathers metrics in a database.
